source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Re-roll a Hit result of 1 for every attack from a qualifying model. Its unit must be friendly, have **SHADOW LEGION** or **LEGIONES DAEMONICA**, and be up to 6″ away from this model.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

effect.trigger: every attack by a qualifying model
